title: Noise-Consistent Siamese-Diffusion for Medical Image Synthesis and Segmentation
mechanism: Mask-Diffusion and Image-Diffusion branches trained with a noise-consistency loss so that the mask-only sampler keeps real morphology; only the mask branch is used at sampling.
adaptation: Train-time add-on to the retrained PV-DDPM (row 2) for inactive, material and corrosion on 478 cells; the image branch uses the real cell as extra condition during training.
min_experiment: Arm: PV-DDPM + noise-consistency loss. Baseline: plain PV-DDPM at matched steps. Metric: house-ensemble inactive IoU on 200 synthetic pairs (adherence), then CV inactive IoU. Kill: adherence gain < 0.05.
evidence: R: SANet mDice +3.6, mIoU +4.4 on polyps; UNet +1.52 / +1.64 on ISIC2018.
